t: G44 Fabrication Engine: Tolerance Stack-Up — Simple
name: G44 Fabrication Engine: Tolerance Stack-Up — Simple
title: G44 Fabrication Engine: Tolerance Stack-Up — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Assemblies accumulate error: the stack-up adds worst-case tolerances linearly and statistical tolerances by root-sum-square. The desk computes both — the assembly either fits or it doesn't, and the math says which.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Worst-case stack of 5x ±0.1 mm = 0.50 mm. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

real_world_basis: Tolerance stack-up is the real, standard method of mechanical design.

math_note: Worst-case stack of 5x ±0.1 mm: 0.50 mm [verified]; RSS stack of 5x ±0.1 mm: 0.224 mm [verified]
safety: No hazard; the failure mode is a stack built on catalog tolerances.
how_it_works: Sum the tolerance chain both ways and compare to the fit requirement. The demo stacks a 5-part housing.
